RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel is a recognized risk factor for unconscious bias, but it does not alone prove discrimination. The selected candidate presented specific management training and broader leadership experience, which the panel may have prioritized over your academic credentials and section-level leadership.

Do not raise bias accusations immediately. First, follow up politely on your request for written feedback. Simultaneously, check hospital recruitment policies to see whether gender-balanced panels are mandated. If the forthcoming feedback is evasive, points to shifting standards, or reveals procedural breaches, consider consulting a union representative or employment specialist before officially raising concerns about process fairness.
